Thank you, Emre. I want to be polite. Do I have to take off my shoes?
Yes, you have to take them off at the door. It is a custom in Turkey. We have slippers for you.
OK. And do I have to bring a gift?
No, you don't have to, but a small box of sweets is very nice.
Perfect. Is it rude to say no to tea?
A little. My mother always offers tea, so say yes, please!

Hi Marlene, this is Emre. Welcome to Istanbul! My mother wants to invite you to dinner at our home on Friday. Here are some Turkish customs, so you feel comfortable. When you arrive, you have to take off your shoes at the door. Do not worry, we have slippers for guests. You do not have to bring a big gift. A small box of sweets or some flowers is perfect. My mother always offers tea, and it is polite to say yes. At the table, you do not have to eat everything, but try a little of each dish. Dinner is at seven o'clock. See you on Friday.

Welcome to the Blue Mosque, everybody. Before we go in, please listen to the rules. This is a working mosque, so it closes to visitors at prayer times, five times a day. You do not have to pay. Entrance is free. You have to take off your shoes, and you can carry them in a plastic bag. Women have to cover their hair with a headscarf. If you do not have a headscarf, you can borrow one at the door. Men and women have to cover their legs and arms. Please speak quietly inside, and do not use a flash for photos. Thank you, and enjoy the visit.

First, you buy a small box of sweets as a gift for the family. Then you arrive at the house and you take off your shoes at the door. Next, the mother offers you tea, and you say yes, because it is polite. After that, you try a little of every dish at dinner. Finally, you thank the family, and you invite them to visit you in Brazil.
